statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
The service is related to diagnoses R55 and G45.9.
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan.
